How to add items

Paste a list from your own notes or from the internet, just make sure each list item gets its own line. You can tidy it up once the list is created.

Skipper's tip: you can add a category in one line and then items for that category then add another category in a new line and then more items, each in their own new line. You can then use the "Indent" feature in the app to collapse your items into the categories you created, much like is done with the First Aid lists. Don't be afraid to add some explanation, in brackets, to your categories - this may really help new crew members. It may also help to number the categories initially to differentiate them from items.
